crossRefs.note: However in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than…
I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air,

translations.web: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.
translations.bsb: So it is with you. Unless you speak intelligible words with your tongue, how will anyone know what you are saying? You will just be speaking into the air.
translations.kjv: So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.
translations.asv: So also ye, unless ye utter by the tongue speech easy to understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye will be speaking into the air.
